description: Expansion - Level 20 compatibility test. P0 — tests high-level progression, Stats, and StaticData.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do if u == 'a2c4b0fc-e745-41df-81b7-fa53950d86a0' then return true end end return false end)(), 'Expansion (Level 20) module present in load order')

assert((function() local entities=Ext.Entity.GetAllEntitiesWithComponent('eoc::character::CharacterComponent'); return type(entities) == 'table' and #entities > 0 end)(), 'loaded-save character entity query executes')

assert((function() Ext.StaticData.ForceCapture(); local entries=Ext.StaticData.GetAll('Feat'); return type(entries) == 'table' and #entries > 0 end)(), 'vanilla feat static data resolves after ForceCapture')
notes: Does not require MCM. Major gameplay mod — levels 13-20, spells 7-9. Tests Stats, progression, StaticData.
